verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik elanh t'a tik yet' heb' chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, tzik'anb'at heb' t'a sat lum lum walnak t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob to ol wak' t'a yinhtilal heb' winh.

Ha in ol in chek b'ab'laj jun wángel t'a eyichanh. A' ol ex kuchb'anb'atok. Ha juntzanh chonhab'il anima, haton heb' kananeo, heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo, ol wik'el heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Ixikek t'a jun lum te yax sat chi', palta manh ol in b'atlaj t'a he kal, yujto te pit ex, ay smay tzex in satel t'a yoltak b'e, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima jun lolonel kuseltak yalji chi', ix och heb' t'a ilk'olal, manhxalaj mach ix yak'och yuchikin yet' stonh.

Yujto a Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a heb' etisraelal tik: Ha ex tik te pit ex. Tato tzin k'och t'a he kal junok rato, ay smay tzex in sateli. Ha tiknaik ik'ekel eyuchikin chi' yet' he tonh t'a he jaj chi', ol wilani tas ol ex wutok, xa chi, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj wal chi', atax ix el heb' t'a yich witz Horeb, manhxo junok heb' ix yak'och stonh yet' yuchikin.

Ix yak' b'ochajk'e jun mantiado winhaj Moisés t'a stib'at kampamento. Ix yak'an winh skuch jun mantiado chi': T'a B'aj Sch'ox Sb'a Jehová. Tato ay junok mach sb'at sk'anb'ej junok tas t'a Jehová, yowalil sb'at t'a jun mantiado chi'.
Ayik sb'at winhaj Moisés t'a mantiado chi', tz'elta linhan heb' anima smasanil t'a stitak smantiado, sb'at k'elan heb' t'a winh masanto tz'ochkan winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.
Ayik tz'och winh, tz'emul moynaj jun asun t'a sti' mantiado chi' yakb'an slolon Jehová yet' winh.
Ha syilan heb' anima chi' yemul moynaj jun asun chi', tz'em nhojan heb' smasanil ejmelal t'a Jehová.

Q'uelk'umb'a wal tz'aj Jehová slolon yet' winhaj Moisés chi', icha wal tz'aj ko lolon yet' junok ko wach'k'ool. Slajwi slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', sjax winh t'a kampamento. Palta haxo winh skolwaj yet' winhaj Moisés chi', haton winhaj Josué kelem winak, yuninal winhaj Nun, skannhej winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová: --Mamin Jehová, a ach ix al t'ayin to a in tzin kuchb'ej jun a chonhab' tik, palta maj al-laj t'ayin mach ol a chek kolwaj wet'ok. Ix halani to ojtak in to ay a tzalajk'olal wet'ok halani.

Yuj chi', tato yel icha chi', ak' wojtakejeli tas nab'il uuj, yik cham tzach wojtakejeli, ol wak'annhej tzalajb'ok a k'ool. Ojtak wal to a jun chonhab' tzak'kanoch t'a yol in k'ab' tik to a chonhab' yaji, xchi winh.
--Ha in wal lak'an ol in b'at het'ok, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a junk'olal t'a lum lum chi', xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Yuj wal chi', ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Yel wal Mamin, tato max ach b'at ket'ok, wach' to max onh ik'el t'a tik.

Tato max ach b'at ket' tiknaik, ¿tas wal tz'aj yojtakajeli, tato ay a tzalajk'olal wet'ok yet' t'a heb' a chonhab' tik? Tato ayachnhejoch ket'ok jun, ol cheklajelok to a chonhab' ton kaji, sik'b'il onh el uuj t'a skal masanil chonhab', xchi winh.
--Ha juntzanh lolonel tzal tik ol in k'ulej, yujto te ay in tzalajk'olal het'ok, wojtak wal a pensar sik'lab'il, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
--Mamin, tzin tewi wal t'ayach to tza ch'ox sniwanil elk'och t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Masanil in wach'k'olal ol in ch'ox t'ayach. Ha wal t'a ichanh ol walel in wach'il to a in ton Jehová in, ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' b'aj syal in k'ol swak'a', ol ok' in k'ool t'a heb' b'aj syal in k'ool.
Palta swal t'ayach to manh ol yal-laj och k'elan t'a in sat, yujto malaj junok mach syal yilan in sat. Tato tz'och k'elan junok mach t'ayin, elanhchamel schami.
Ina t'a in lak'anil ay jun lugar b'aj ol yal a k'ekan linhan t'a yib'anh jun niwan k'een.
Ayik ol ek'b'at in tzikikial ta', ol ach wak'anoch t'a yol spojelal k'een k'een chi', ol ach in makchankanoch yet' in k'ab' yakb'an tzin ek'kanb'ati.
Ayik ol lajwok wek'kani, ol wik'anel in k'ab', haxonhej in patik ol yal hilani, haxo in sat manh wal jab'ok ol yal hilani, xchi Jehová.
